focus: Three of the site's own safety checks were quietly not working. One had switched off an alarm meant to catch a release that never reaches readers; one had left the site's speed check failing for over a day without saying so; and one could not notice when the test environment falls behind the live site — it now measures exactly how far, and it is five days and 23 pages behind. All three are fixed or measured, and everything here is live: the site was fully redeployed and verified.
nextStep: Finish the browser-security migration so the strictest setting can be switched on safely, then the rendered-pixel review of the newly-served pages. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.
